answer: A meadow has only so many plots. Each epoch, 30 basalt plots open; entry locks 70 POA, +45 per extra identity from one root, so ten linked fakes lock 2,725 POA. Each plot needs six shale inspections in one 30-minute window, each co-signed by a stranger, at most two per surveyor. One operator tends two plots: ten fakes need five hands, sixty inspections, thirty surveyors at once. A missed inspection burns 20; self-signing is void. The ledger checks roots: one hand behind two plots leaves one standing. The bond is the easy half; the hard half is thirty live strangers in one window.
